outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcome at 2 years of age, assessed using the Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ)
cohort: Twins born at >=32 weeks gestation in a single center who were not randomized in the Twin Birth Study
finding: There were no significant differences in abnormal neurodevelopment scores on the ASQ at two years of age between twins born by planned cesarean section and those born by planned vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Pediatric assessment suggested a possible increased incidence of abnormal neurodevelopment in twins B born by planned vaginal delivery.
